IntDiv in subnet-2-circom.Short Description of the Vulnerability: The IntDiv template assigns quotient and remainder using unconstrained hints without sufficient validation. While constraints are attempted through Num2Bits, the mathematical proof relies on potentially inadequate bit-width constraints that may not fully prevent invalid quotient/remainder pairs.
IntDiv in subnet-2-circom.Short Description of the Exploit: An attacker can provide invalid quotient or remainder values that satisfy the weak constraints but violate the intended division invariant.
IntDiv in subnet-2-circom.Proposed Mitigation: Add rigorous range checks using Num2Bits and explicit LessThan constraints to ensure remainder < divisor and quotient/remainder are valid.
